description: Defines the QueryFilter class used for filtering display based on entities like Manufacturer, including properties for filter code, id, and type.

classes.name: QueryFilter
classes.description: A Java class used for filtering entities in category and search operations within the web shop module.

methods.name: getFilterCode
methods.description: Returns the filter code used for filtering by entity code.

methods.name: setFilterCode
methods.description: Sets the filter code used for filtering by entity code.

methods.name: getFilterId
methods.description: Returns the filter id used for filtering by entity id.

methods.name: setFilterId
methods.description: Sets the filter id used for filtering by entity id.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Returns the filter type indicating filter criteria.

methods.name: setFilterType
methods.description: Sets the filter type indicating filter criteria.
